payload.text: I need a website to offer digital innovation service to organizations. I will develop custom apps and web apps. Please build a website to position me as one of the top tech companies in Kenya. The website name is digispot, digital innovation hub.

**Envisioning the Website**

I'm now focusing on the visual direction for "digispot." My aim is to create a high-end, professional website that embodies both innovation and professionalism. I'm leaning towards clean, modern design with a high-tech feel, all while capturing the essence of a digital innovation hub in Kenya.


**Defining the UI Elements**

I'm solidifying the website's core structure. I envision distinct sections: a compelling value proposition in the hero, service descriptions, a portfolio showcasing case studies, and an about us segment detailing our vision for Kenya and Africa. I'll include a contact form, and also a blog, possibly with AI-generated content. Testimonials will be important. Also, I'm now exploring AI integration.

I'm considering a floating AI assistant named "Spot" and an AI-powered project estimator, both using Google Gemini. The tech stack will use React with Tailwind CSS and Lucide.
